newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Boeing wins Australian radio contract.
newsitem.headline: Boeing wins Australian radio contract.

text.p: The Australian government on Thursday named Boeing Australia Ltd, a unit of U.S. aerospace giant Boeing Co, as the preferred bidder to develop a high frequency radio system for Australian defence force ships and aircraft in Australia and the region.
Defence Minister Ian McLachlan said the system, which would be operational early next century, would provide long range communications through four new ground stations.
The stations would be controlled by a network management operation at a site yet to be determined.

"The system will represent a substantial increase in capability over the existing system, allowing nine currently used communications facilities to be closed down with associated savings in personnel and operating costs," McLachlan said in a statement.
